end.summary: Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming line directions using familiar examples such as standing, sleeping, a slide and a kite string. They correctly explained that a slanting line is still straight when it does not turn. They mixed up a cornered zigzag or kite-side line with a curved line, and this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, draw straight, curved, and zigzag lines together and ask Om to trace each one and say whether it turns.
